what: Raw evaluations to success of Goldman and Punch (2015), IEEE TEVC 19(3):359-373, all configurations (their make_rdata.py output). The CGP validation uses the 50 rows problem=parity, duplication=single, ordering=normal, genome_size=500 (Table II, Single-Normal, 3-bit parity).
